description: Na₃LiY₃CP₃O₁₅F₂ crystallizes in the cubic P̅43m space group. Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.87 Å. Li is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (1.93 Å) and three longer (2.51 Å) Li-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Y sites. In the first Y site, Y is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.15-2.48 Å. In the second Y site, Y is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O and four F atoms. All Y-O bond lengths are 2.29 Å. There are two shorter (2.31 Å) and two longer (2.34 Å) Y-F bond lengths. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.29 Å. P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are three shorter (1.53 Å) and one longer (1.55 Å) P-O bond length. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, one Y, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, one Y, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Li, two equivalent Y, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Y, and one P atom. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three equivalent Y atoms. In the second F site, F is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three equivalent Y atoms.
